done_when: README.md describes the per-repo merge setting and forge merge, shows the v1.1.0 install line, has an Upgrading section that says to tell the agent to upgrade Forge to a named version, lists forge merge and forge ask in its commands table, and links the explainer video from the v1.1.0 release with a preview image; no video or video source is committed, only links to the release assets

dismissals.because: README.md:10 the owner replaced the preview image with GitHub's inline player (uploaded in issue 377); the video stays a v1.1.0 release asset, linked on README.md:12, and nothing video is committed

findings.body: The explainer block adds a user-attachment URL and a separate text download link, but no preview image linked to the release video. Even if GitHub renders the attachment inline, that URL is not a release asset, contrary to the explicit acceptance criteria. Replace it with a linked preview image whose image and video URLs both reference the v1.1.0 release assets. This requirement can be completed within this branch.
findings.title: Not done: Link the v1.1.0 explainer with a preview image using only release assets

why: The README still says only a human merges, shows the v1.0.2 install line, doesn't say how to upgrade a repo or list forge merge and forge ask, and has no explainer video
